mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph network to the body was most worthwhile: the planned before-and-after views connect ongoing filtration and lymph return to fluid balance, rather than presenting drainage as a static pipe.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate collecting-route and venous-junction combinations felt somewhat repetitive, although each made a different segment of the route visible.

surprise.text: The supplied-body result also showed motor pathways to the breathing muscles, linking nervous control to ventilation while the main task was blood supply.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the marked duct outlet made the separate venous-junction step understandable, even if the sequence was predictable.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it offered similarly concrete system connections. The planned illustrations and comparisons made this integration interesting, though they do not demonstrate how students would understand finished artwork.
